abilities.name: Anchor Hook
abilities.text: Hurl Homboldt forward and grapple towards the target it hits. The impact briefly stuns an enemy.
abilities.tip: Plan the landing before you throw: Hook takes Swiggins into the fight, so nearby allies matter.

abilities.name: Drop Anchor
abilities.text: Throw Homboldt in an arc to tether an enemy Naut. The target can destroy the anchor to escape.
abilities.tip: Once Homboldt is on the ground, Swiggins uses Ink Spray. Retrieve the anchor to recover his melee attack and Hook.

abilities.name: Anchor Swing / Ink Spray
abilities.text: Swing Homboldt at close range while carrying it. With the anchor dropped, attack at range using Ink Spray.
abilities.tip: The two attacks are alternate states: Anchor Swing while carrying Homboldt, Ink Spray while it is dropped.

abilities.name: Ink Propulsion
abilities.text: Jump and propel upward with ink to hover briefly, helping the admiral navigate obstacles.
abilities.tip: Use the brief hover to adjust your route through platforms and obstacles.

default.name: DEFAULT
default.description: The Royal Fleet uniform, captain’s cap and glass tank. Swiggins carries Homboldt, the anchor from his old ship.

phd.name: SWIGGINS, PHD
phd.description: Inspired by Dr. Fetus from Super Meat Boy: a tiny pilot inside a glass tank, mechanical tentacles, a dark suit and tie, a top hat and monocle. Homboldt wears bandages.

abyssal.name: ABYSSAL SWIGGINS
abyssal.description: A deep-sea creature with red eyes and a forehead glyph, without the usual cap or glass tank. Faces decorate the claw, armor and anchor; a tentacle replaces the hook chain. Includes an altered voice set.
